I am looking at my library opening-hours page in Chrome on my laptop. I only want to save this page, not every tab. What do I click?

To save just the page you are viewing:
1. Select **Bookmark this page** to the right of Chrome's address bar.

This saves the current page.

The mouse arrow on my Windows 11 computer is so small I lose it. Can I make the pointer bigger?

I got to Mouse pointer and touch already. What do I do here? Please do not change the pointer color.

You are already on the right page.
1. Under **Mouse pointer**, adjust the **Size** slider until the arrow is easier to see.

Leave **Mouse pointer style** unchanged so the color stays as it is.
